claim: MOFCOM/GACC Announcement 2025 No. 18 lists the sputtering targets of all seven controlled rare earths (samarium, gadolinium, terbium, dysprosium, lutetium, scandium, yttrium) under reference customs codes 3824999922 and 8486909110.
evidence: "Samarium-containing targets (Reference customs codes: 3824999922, 8486909110)" … "Lutetium target (Reference customs codes: 3824999922, 8486909110)" … "Scandium target (Reference customs codes: 3824999922, 8486909110)" (Sections I-VII, item a.3)
notes: Corrects CLM-1388: the announcement itself does not describe what 8486909110 covers.

claim: According to a May 2025 Junzejun law-firm analysis, Chinese customs code 8486909110 covers dual-use-controlled sputtering target assemblies with backing plates (requiring a dual-use export licence), split out of code 84869091 (sputtering target assemblies with backing plates) after the April 2025 rare-earth controls.
evidence: Table: "8486909110 | 两用物项管制的带背板的溅射靶材组件 | 13% | 3"; "8486909190 | 其他的带背板的溅射靶材组件"; "'3'是指两用物项和技术出口许可证"; "…并对商品编码进行了修改，包括'84869091'进行了细化" (Section 三)
notes: Tier-3 secondary source; trace to GACC tariff catalogue for higher confidence.

claim: Under Article 12 of Decree No. 792, each period of temporary dual-use control may last no more than 2 years and a temporary control may be extended no more than twice; long-term controls go on the dual-use control list.
evidence: "临时管制的实施期限每次不超过2年。…（二）需要继续实施管制但不宜列入两用物项出口管制清单的，延长临时管制，延长临时管制不超过2次；（三）需要长期实施管制的，列入两用物项出口管制清单。" (Art. 12)
notes: Refines CLM-1361 (Export Control Law Art. 9) for dual-use items.
